reviewMethod: Each sampled listing was reviewed against its title plus the first ~1,400 characters of stored description/summary. Labels are conservative: ambiguous multi-family roles and evidence-free rows stay out of the accuracy denominator.

sampling.frame: All 710 active listings captured 2026-11-05, grouped by source and predicted role family.
sampling.method: Deterministic MD5 ordering within each source x predicted-family stratum, one guaranteed listing per source, then round-robin across strata, plus a targeted seniority-span stratum.

scope: Stratified sample of tracked active listings, not a census. Accuracy is role-family correctness only; seniority spans are audited separately and are not part of the accuracy denominator.
